'''Heglum''' was a very light [[Gas/Legends|gas]] used in [[dirigible]]s. Sometimes found inside of [[Nebula/Legends|nebulae]], it quickly bonded to a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drives]]. Ships passing through heglum clouds need to undergo regular drive scrubbing in order to remain at optimal performance.<ref name="CSWE" /> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stroiketcy]] had heglum, [[Malsarr/Legends|malsarr]], and [[Iridium (element)/Legends|iridium]] suspended in its surface [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]].<ref name="GG2" /> The [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]] was thick with both heglum and iridium.<ref name="Home" />
